calculation_handling.description: Up to 5 dwelling units converted from interior floor area of a lawfully existing apartment building on a lot with 100 or more dwelling units are exempt from regulation 10.5.30.1(2) (water main and sewer capacity on major streets).
calculation_handling.gaps: Displaces 10.5.30.1(2) for the converted units only; needs the existing building's unit count and lawful status. dwelling_units is read as the lot's existing unit count, an approximation.

units.disclosure: Converting common areas of a large existing apartment building (100+ units) into up to 5 new units is exempt from the water/sewer capacity rule; we do not evaluate existing-building conversions.

calculation_handling.description: Adds an exclusion to the gross floor area of an apartment building: the area converted to additional dwelling units under 10.10.20.60 is deducted, in addition to the areas in 10.5.40.40(4).
calculation_handling.gaps: Needs the converted area of an existing building, which we do not hold.

units.disclosure: Floor area converted to new units under this conversion rule is not counted in the building's gross floor area; not evaluated.

calculation_handling.description: The converted units are exempt from 10.10.40.1(3) and any 900.2.10 prevailing provision on the maximum number of dwelling units on the lot.
calculation_handling.gaps: Displaces 10.10.40.1(3) and article 900.2.10 unit-count provisions for the converted units only.

units.disclosure: Up to 5 converted units in a large existing apartment building do not count against the maximum number of units; not evaluated.

calculation_handling.description: The converted units are exempt from 10.10.40.40(1) and any 900.2.10 prevailing provision on maximum floor space index.
calculation_handling.gaps: Displaces the FSI limit for the converted units only; needs existing-building facts.

units.disclosure: Up to 5 converted units in a large existing apartment building are exempt from the floor space index limit; not evaluated.

calculation_handling.description: The converted units are exempt from 10.10.40.50(1) and any 900.2.10 prevailing provision on additional minimum amenity space.
calculation_handling.gaps: Amenity space is not a DSL target; displacement applies to the converted units only.

units.disclosure: Up to 5 converted units in a large existing apartment building need no additional amenity space; not evaluated.

calculation_handling.description: The converted units are exempt from 200.5.10.1(1), Table 200.5.10.1 and any 900.2.10 prevailing provision on additional minimum visitor parking spaces.
calculation_handling.gaps: Displaces visitor parking requirements for the converted units only.

units.disclosure: Up to 5 converted units in a large existing apartment building need no additional visitor parking; not evaluated.

calculation_handling.description: The converted units are exempt from 200.15.10.5(1), Table 200.15.10.5 and any 900.2.10 prevailing provision on minimum additional accessible parking spaces.
calculation_handling.gaps: Displaces accessible parking requirements for the converted units only.

units.disclosure: Up to 5 converted units in a large existing apartment building need no additional accessible parking; not evaluated.

calculation_handling.description: The converted units are exempt from any 900.2.10 prevailing provision on additional minimum residential occupant parking spaces.
calculation_handling.gaps: Displaces only article 900.2.10 provisions; the base parking reduction is governed by 10.10.20.60(2).

units.disclosure: Up to 5 converted units in a large existing apartment building need no additional resident parking under site-specific provisions; not evaluated.

calculation_handling.description: The converted units are exempt from 220.5.10.1(1) and (2) and any 900.2.10 prevailing provision on additional minimum loading spaces.
calculation_handling.gaps: Displaces loading space requirements for the converted units only.

units.disclosure: Up to 5 converted units in a large existing apartment building need no additional loading spaces; not evaluated.

calculation_handling.description: The converted units are exempt from 230.5.10.1(5) and any 900.2.10 prevailing provision on additional long-term and short-term bicycle parking spaces.
calculation_handling.gaps: Displaces bicycle parking requirements for the converted units only.

units.disclosure: Up to 5 converted units in a large existing apartment building need no additional bicycle parking; not evaluated.

calculation_handling.description: For compliance with 10.10.20.60, a lawful existing parking space or drive aisle smaller than the required minimum length, width or vertical clearance is deemed to meet the minimum at its lawful dimension, provided no alteration increases the noncompliance after June 26, 2025.
calculation_handling.gaps: Grandfathers several as-built dimensions (parking space length, width, vertical clearance; drive aisle width) at once; no single DSL target and no as-built input, so keyed UNUSUAL rather than an existing() LIMIT.

units.disclosure: Existing undersized parking spaces and drive aisles in the building are treated as compliant for this conversion if not made worse after June 26, 2025; not evaluated.

calculation_handling.description: Despite 200.5.10.11(1)(C), lawful resident occupant parking spaces of a lawfully existing building may be reduced for a conversion under 10.10.20.60(1), if the converted spaces are within a building and at least 1 residential occupant parking space per lawfully existing dwelling unit is maintained.
calculation_handling.gaps: The zone is not named in this clause; keyed to R from the article context (10.10 is the R zone) with no zone evidence phrase. The rate counts lawfully existing dwelling units, not proposed units. The 'located within a building' proviso is not expressed.

units.disclosure: When converting common areas to units, existing resident parking may be reduced to 1 space per existing unit, using spaces inside the building; not evaluated.

calculation_handling.description: Condition of the 10.10.20.60(1)/(2) exemptions: converted dwelling units must comply with 5.10.1.30(3)(A) on dwelling units below grade, unless a Section 45 minor variance authorizes otherwise.
calculation_handling.gaps: Applies only to the existing-building conversion path; zone keyed from article context.

units.disclosure: Converted units below grade must meet the below-grade unit rule in 5.10.1.30(3)(A); not evaluated.

calculation_handling.description: Condition of the exemptions: interior floor area used for lawfully existing dwelling units may not be converted to additional dwelling units, unless a Section 45 minor variance authorizes it.
calculation_handling.gaps: Existing-building conversion path; zone keyed from article context.

units.disclosure: Existing units cannot be split into extra units under this conversion rule; not evaluated.

calculation_handling.description: Condition of the exemptions: interior floor area used for lawfully existing amenity space may not be reduced, unless a Section 45 minor variance authorizes it.
calculation_handling.gaps: Amenity space is not modelled; zone keyed from article context.

units.disclosure: Existing indoor amenity space cannot be reduced by the conversion; not evaluated.

calculation_handling.description: Condition of the exemptions: the lawful number of visitor and accessible parking spaces of a lawfully existing building may not be reduced, unless a Section 45 minor variance authorizes it.
calculation_handling.gaps: Existing-building conversion path; zone keyed from article context.

units.disclosure: Existing visitor and accessible parking cannot be reduced by the conversion; not evaluated.

calculation_handling.description: Condition of the exemptions: the lawful number of long-term and short-term bicycle parking spaces of a lawfully existing building may not be reduced, unless a Section 45 minor variance authorizes it.
calculation_handling.gaps: Existing-building conversion path; zone keyed from article context.

units.disclosure: Existing bicycle parking cannot be reduced by the conversion; not evaluated.

calculation_handling.description: Condition of the exemptions: interior floor area used for common facilities secured as an improvement by registered City agreements may not be converted to additional dwelling units, unless a Section 45 minor variance authorizes it.
calculation_handling.gaps: Requires knowledge of registered City agreements on title, which we do not hold.

units.disclosure: Common facilities secured by a City agreement on title cannot be converted to units; not evaluated.

calculation_handling.description: For 10.10.20.60(1)-(3), lawful / lawfully existing also includes buildings, structures or uses authorized or permitted on or before June 26, 2025.
calculation_handling.gaps: Definition of a term, no DSL variable; zone keyed from article context.

units.disclosure: none

calculation_handling.description: For 10.10.20.60(1)-(3), lawful / lawfully existing also includes anything for which a building permit was lawfully issued before June 26, 2025.
calculation_handling.gaps: Definition of a term, no DSL variable; zone keyed from article context.

units.disclosure: none

10.10.20.60(1).explanation: In a large existing apartment building (100 or more units on the lot), up to 5 new units can be created from interior common space, and those units are exempt from several rules: servicing capacity, unit count, floor space index, amenity space, visitor, accessible, resident and bicycle parking, and loading. Existing undersized parking stays compliant. MaxBLD does not evaluate these existing-building conversions.

10.10.20.60(2).explanation: For such a conversion, existing resident parking may be reduced, as long as the converted spaces are inside a building and at least 1 resident space per existing unit remains. Not evaluated.

10.10.20.60(3).explanation: The conversion exemptions only apply if below-grade unit rules are met, existing units, amenity space, visitor, accessible and bicycle parking are not reduced, and secured common facilities are kept, unless a minor variance is granted. Not evaluated.

10.10.20.60(4).explanation: For these conversion rules, 'lawfully existing' includes anything permitted on or before June 26, 2025 or with a building permit issued before that date.
